title: Signed voice model catalog envelope (#1816)
description: The file the app downloads. 'payload' is the base64 of a voice-model-catalog.schema.json document, byte for byte as signed, so there is no re-serialising for the signer and verifier to disagree about. 'signature' is the base64 Ed25519 signature over the ASCII line "SpokenMargins-VoiceModelCatalog-v1\n" followed by the payload bytes. The app trusts only keys compiled into the build, looked up by keyId, so a key is rotated by shipping the new key in one build and signing with it once that build is out. Missing or bad signature, an unknown keyId or algorithm, or a payload that doesn't decode rejects the whole catalog.
